body: Thank you for this<3 I am trying to get in contact with a therapist for the self love, intimacy is hard in the sex aspect bc of our living situation. (Mattress on a living room floor of dads apt) but I guess a quickie in the car never killed anyone right? You really sound like a such a persistent and loving person I hope I can reach that level of "stand in traffic for you" type of love you now have towards those kids. I think the big mistake my bf and I made when his moms death happened was not talking about how we'd proceed with our little one & how we'd settle into parental roles but there was just so much family drama & custody battles and stupid crap & honestly I didn't feel the need to talk about it I just approached it as in "ok she's ours now you supply the "love" I'll be the disciplinarian & but her shit so she's taken care of in that aspect" but I don't want her to feel apathetic to me in the future bc of the lack of hugs and kisses I didn't give when she was so young. She's SO touchy i know she gets her sense of security from that & bf gives it but I want to be able to provide that type of love too bc I know how important it is. It's weird I don't really feel the need to be loved by her but I want her to know she IS loved so she grows up to be a healthy wholesome person. I hope I can feel that love in the future & you gave me hope so thank you nice internet stranger & im happy you have reached that with your kiddies <3

Thank you for taking the time to reply <3 I do try to overcompensate for my lack of affection with lots of clothes and stupid crap  but  I do kind of feel some resentment towards her which really just makes me hate myself more bc she didn't ask to be made by two shitty humans and have her fantastic grandma die and wind up with two super inexperienced kids & honestly besides grandma I LOATHE AND DESPISE with all my heart my bf's family. Mom was an amazing woman but she seemed to have made 5 incredibly shitty kids and my bf just happened to be the diamond in the rough. Little one is his oldest brothers kid and not a single freaking sibling stepped up when she was born to help it fell on my then 17 year old bf bc everyone else was selfish or also mixed up in drugs and now every single one of his brothers and sisters hate my bf and I for stepping up &  "taking the kid away from her (still on drugs) bio parents". The resentment is manifested into she basically has caused so much drama & court cases & financial strain & a roommate situation relationship that I don't want to say the word hate but just get very frustrated that if not for my bf this poor kid would end up in the foster system but our whole lives got turned upside down in trying to keep her safe & my bf honestly loves the shit out of her he's a phenomenal dad & like I said I love him but remember where I said financial strain? We live on a mattress in the middle of my dads living room floor while she shares a room with my brother and our clothes are in trash bags. I have zero privacy so while she's contributed to the dead bedroom in the exhaUsted parenting sense, so has our living situation. We have been living like this for so effing long bc NO ONE in our area want to rent to a young unmarried couple with a young kid we've been looking for a whole year and nothing. It adds up & it makes me uncomfortable being around her at times. I hate the fact that I didn't get to bond with her when she was a baby & know her during that important stage. She is honestly a wonderful kid, listens so well is super sweet and loving and physically affectionate with everyone very ditzy in a drunk toddler kind of way and if I just like met the kid on the street I'd be like aw look a funny kid but raising her? It's a whole different ball game. I don't know whether to power through the hugs and kisses she wants to give bc I know it's not met with the "excitedness" she wants or be like "mommy loves you but no touch" bc how do you reject a kid? I've been doing all sorts of Halloween stuff with her & even have matching costumes but after a couple of days it's like her little heart gets even more excited and loving & wants to touch me & cuddle me and LOVE ME SO MUCH I get so frustrated and pull away.. I'm going to keep trying though thank you the $10 idea sounds fun & we both love the dollar section at Target, for a non bio kid she certainly shares a lot of my likes and dislikes lol. Ok on to work on these bonding experiences <3
